_comment: Detection rates as measured on the date this file was written. These are a floor, not a target. The eval fails when a class detects fewer cases than its baseline. Raising a number here is a deliberate act, done only after verifying a real improvement in the detectors, never to make the eval pass. swapped_citation was closed by citecheck: attribution() now builds its sidecar index corpus-wide instead of per-entity, so a citation repointed at another entity's source is looked up correctly instead of falling through to the domain fallback -- 0/6 -> 6/6, verified against the eval with no other class moving.
